description: Selran plugins — developer methodology and design tools by Selran. Greenloop: the convergent audit/fix loop that runs until green. Design Director: high-quality visual work with AI-slop blocked.

plugins.name: greenloop
plugins.description: Selran Greenloop — the loop that runs until green. Point it at any codebase and it maps the architecture, reconstructs the spec, audits against ten quality categories, fixes what it finds, and adversarially re-verifies — repeating until nothing is left to fix. Five skills: cartographer, spec-bootstrap, pre-commit-verification, app-audit, audit-fix. Free for personal, non-commercial use.

plugins.name: design-director
plugins.description: Selran Design Director — stop shipping the default AI look. Pick from seven rendered design directions, get a portable design-system.md, and have it enforced on everything Claude builds — websites, apps, native mobile, documents, decks — with dark mode, accessibility audits, i18n, and performance budgets built in. MIT core; independently licensed add-on packs.
